data.title: Blue Owl readies $513M CMBS sale to fund Amazon-leased data center - report
data.description:
Blue Owl Capital Inc. (OWL) is readying the sale of $513M of commercial mortgage-backed securities to finance the acquisition of a Northern Virginia data center that's leased to Amazon.com, according to a media report on Thursday.

The financing, to be led by Citigroup (C), consists of three tranches — including two public offerings and one private placement, Bloomberg News reported, citing people with knowledge of the matter.

Some $375M of bonds, with an average life of about five years, are expected to be rated AAA by Fitch Ratings and Kroll Bond Rating Agency, the report said. The initial price being discussed is ~1.95 percentage points over the benchmark.

The second portion, amounting to ~$112M, also with an average life of about five years, is expected to be rated AA by Kroll; initial price talk is ~2.6 pp over the benchmark, the people told Bloomberg.

The remaining $26M tranche, with an expected rating of AA- by Kroll, is being placed privately, they said.

The CMBS is backed by the mortgage on the 54-megawatt Project Crossing III data center, the people told Bloomberg. Amazon's (AMZN) lease started in March and lasts through 2041, with two five-year renewal options. The company isn't involved in the financing, the report said.

Blue Owl Capital Inc. (OWL) stock was unchanged in premarket trading.

data.title: Hydrofarm names Eric Ceresnie as CEO, and William Toler as Executive Chairman
data.description:
• Hydrofarm Holdings Group (HYFM) announced on Thursday it named Eric Ceresnie as CEO, effective Jan. 1, 2027, succeeding William Toler, who will become executive chairman of the board.

  • Ceresnie brings eight years of experience at Hydrofarm, most recently serving as senior vice president of corporate development and international markets.

  • The leadership transition follows Hydrofarm's recapitalization, which eliminated $109M in debt and reduced annual debt-service obligations by approximately $12M.

  • Mark Parker will step down as President on Dec. 31, 2026, after which the company will eliminate the position and distribute its responsibilities across the executive leadership team. 

  • Share -2.28%

data.title: Appaloosa, Altimeter raise Micron stakes in Q3; Soros Capital cuts position
data.description:
Several prominent hedge funds boosted their positions in Micron Technology (MU) during Q3 2026, according to their latest 13F filings.

Notable moves:

  • Appaloosa (David Tepper): Increased stake by 28% to 1.25M shares.
  • Altimeter (Brad Gerstner): Raised holdings by 24% to 260K shares.
  • Soros Fund (George Soros): Increased position to ~36K shares from 22.4K.
  • Discovery Capital (Rob Citrone): Expanded stake to ~15K shares from 1.4K.

Not everyone was buying: Robert Soros' Soros Capital cut its MU position by approximately 74% to 9.4K shares from 36.7K.

Meanwhile, Micron shares declined during the quarter. The stock closed at $1,154.29 on June 30 and $1,065.11 on September 30, marking a decline of $89.18, or approximately 7.7%, in Q3.

data.title: UGI to spin off global LPG business into public company
data.description:
UGI Corp. (UGI) fell 2.2% pre-market Thursday after beating Q3 adjusted earnings expectations and unveiling a plan to separate its global LPG business into a standalone publicly traded company through a spinoff, expected to be completed in H2 2027.

The new standalone LPG company is expected to be a scaled leader in Europe and the largest retail propane distributor in the U.S.

The new LPG company would include UGI International, which distributes LPG across nine European countries, and AmeriGas Propane, which serves 950K customers in 49 states from 1,300 distribution locations.

"With resilient unit margins, a targeted EBITDA margin of 17%-20%, and expected growth in free cash flow, the new LPG company will be well positioned to deliver a compelling and growing dividend," UGI (UGI) said.

The new UGI (UGI) would be a premier natural gas infrastructure company with fully regulated natural gas utilities and complementary midstream assets located in a favorable long-term supply basin, with direct access to low-cost Marcellus and Utica supply.

UGI (UGI) would operate UGI Utilities, the second largest regulated natural gas utility in Pennsylvania, serving 700K customers across 46 counties; Mountaineer Gas, the largest regulated natural gas utility in West Virginia, serving 209K customers across 55 counties; and UGI Energy Services, which includes natural gas pipeline and gathering assets with a total capacity of 5.1 MMdth/day and storage facilities with 15 Bcf of capacity, as well as LNG peaking assets.

The company projects its regulated rate base of $5B to grow by 8%-10% annually.

data.title: Walmart raises its sales outlook as AI agents pitch in
data.description:
Walmart (WMT) traded slightly lower in early action on Thursday as investors assessed the retail giant's third-quarter earnings report and outlook for the holiday quarter. Notably, AI agents helped Walmart (WMT) see higher average e-commerce basket sizes. 

Comparable sales in the U.S. rose 2.9% to edge past the consensus estimate of +2.8%. Transactions were 1.5% higher during the quarter, and the average ticket was 1.4% higher compared to a year ago. Membership fee revenue increased double-digits with strong Walmart+ net adds, including new bundled memberships. Operating expenses deleveraged 45 basis points due primarily to depreciation expense and higher claims costs.

Comparable sales were 4.9% higher for the Sam's Club chain vs. the +4.6% consensus, driven by transactions and unit volumes with strength in grocery and general merchandise. Membership fee revenue grew 2.2% driven by steady growth in member counts and Plus penetration, partially offset by the allocation of fees from the bundled membership.

International sales for the retail giant rose 7.0% year-over-year to $35.9B on broad-based strength.

Notably, Walmart's (WMT) global advertising business grew approximately 25% during the quarter.

Walmart's (WMT) operating income was up 5.5% on an adjusted basis. Adjusted EPS came in at $0.65 to top the consensus mark of $0.64.

Walmart (WMT) ended the quarter with a cash position of $13.4B and total debt of $64.3B. Free cash flow was $6.8B during the quarter. Walmart's (WMT) inventory level was up 8.1% year-over-year to $70.6B.

Looking ahead, Walmart (WMT) guided for full-year revenue growth of 4.9% to 5.2% and EPS of $2.84 to $2.89 (midpoint $2.865) vs. the $2.89 consensus. CEO John Furner said during a media interview that the company had a strong back-to-school season and is seeing strong trends ahead of Thanksgiving.

On Seeking Alpha, analyst  Justin Purohit noted Walmart's (WMT) 4.5% overall constant currency sales growth was solid, but said the real highlight was the continued momentum in e-commerce, with U.S. online sales increasing 23%. "This stands in contrast to its brick-and-mortar business, where comparable sales growth continues to trail its digital channel," updated Purohit. "I see this as a big win for WMT, particularly given the substantial capital and investment the retailer has committed to building out its e-commerce capabilities in recent years," he added. While Purohit likes the underlying WMTperformance and outlook, he continues to view shares as a Hold at current levels.

Shares of Walmart (WMT) fell 0.6% in premarket action on Thursday. Target (TGT), Costco (COST), Dollar General (DG), Best Buy (BBY), and Dollar Tree (DLTR) were mixed. ETFs with double-digit weighting of Walmart (WMT) in their portfolio include Global X PureCap MSCI Consumer Staples ETF (GXPS), Fidelity MSCI Consumer Staples Index ETF (FSTA), Vanguard Consumer Staples Index Fund ETF (VDC), Vanguard Consumer Staples Index Fund ETF (RTH), and State Street Consumer Staples ETF (XLP).

SmartKem slips 10%, announces 1-for-5 reverse stock split
data.description:
• SmartKem (SMTK) board of directors approved a 1-for-5 reverse stock split of its common stock as the company seeks to support its continued Nasdaq listing.
  • The reverse stock split will become effective on November 20, 2026, at 5 p.m. ET, with shares beginning split-adjusted trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market at the opening of trading on November 23 under the existing ticker symbol SMTK.
  • The stock price slipped about 10% on Thursday pre-market trade.

data.title: Aurania announces non-brokered private placement of up to C$2M
data.description:
• Aurania Resources (ARU:CA) (AUIAF) on Thursday announced its intention to complete a non-brokered private placement financing of up to 10M units of the company at a price of C$0.20 per unit for aggregate gross proceeds to the company of up to C$2M.
  • The company has reserved the right to increase the size of the offering by up to 25% of the size of the offering, such that up to an additional 2.5M units may be issued to raise additional gross proceeds of up to C$500,000.
  • Each unit will consist of one common share of the company and one common share purchase warrant. Each warrant will entitle the holder to purchase one common share at an exercise price of C$0.50 per warrant share for a period of 36 months following the closing of the offering.
  • The company intends to use the net proceeds from the offering for exploration at the company's mineral properties and for working capital purposes.
  • Closing of the offering is anticipated to be completed on or about December 9.
  • Certain directors and officers of the company are expected to acquire units under the offering. 
  • Press release
